title: Android window: the desktop window under NativeActivity, with the bundled font and the soft keyboard for text fields
spec: A crate apps/crewcraft-android (cdylib and rlib, no Java source) whose Android-only entry point android_main (the one #[unsafe(no_mangle)] item, the crate's only exception to the workspace's unsafe_code forbid, which it lowers to deny) starts logcat logging (tag CrewCraft) with version_line() = `crewcraft <version> (protocol <major>.<minor>) on Android`, and runs eframe (glow, android-native-activity; no accesskit, which needs GameActivity on Android) with crewcraft::app::DesktopApp::with_data_dir, which installs crewcraft_desktop_ui::fonts() and opens the same Window as the desktop, with its data in data_dir(internal data path) = <internal>/crewcraft. Around it, after each frame, the soft keyboard is shown explicitly (show_soft_input) when keyboard_wanted(platform output) (egui asks for IME, i.e. a text field has the focus) and hidden when not, only on a change (keyboard_change). Off Android the crate holds only the pure functions. apps/crewcraft takes eframe with accesskit, wgpu, wayland and x11 on every target but Android, and glow with android-native-activity on Android; device_name() is `CrewCraft on Android` there, and the no-key-store message says the phone's key store is not used yet (T403).
